stem:
Meena prepares a glass of nimbu pani at home by dissolving sugar and a few drops of lemon juice in a glass of water.

Which substance is the solvent in this solution?

options.text: sugar, because it is a solid
lemon juice, because it is added in the smallest amount
sugar syrup, because it forms on mixing
water, because it is present in the largest amount

teacher.key_rationale: The solvent is the component present in the largest amount; in nimbu pani water is the bulk liquid, so water is the solvent while sugar and lemon juice are solutes.
